name: expression-failed
description: Entities whose before-hooks read a quantity a client sends as text with int(): a text that is no whole number is the caller's own data refusing a built-in, which answers 422 expression-failed on every engine and writes nothing.

lots.description: A stock lot whose quantity arrives as text.

action.reject: A lot holds at most 9999 pieces.

crates.description: A crate whose first update hook rewrites the quantity only when a stored seal is open: a later refusal of that quantity answers 500 whether or not the first hook fired, so the status reveals nothing about the stored seal.

action.reject: A crate holds at most 9999 pieces.
